question: Which boon-giving goddess of speech is invoked to grant protection?
premises: Protection is requested for the speaker
The protector is the boon-giving Vāṇī
She is the beloved of Baṭukeśvara
inference: The boon-giving Vāṇī, beloved of Baṭukeśvara, is asked to protect the speaker
plain_english: May the boon-giving Vāṇī, the beloved of Baṭukeśvara, protect me.
